item.name: Gale Guard

effects.title: Cyclonic Shield
effects.text: Envelops the caster in an all damage barrier that absorbs 75% of incoming damage up to a max of 225. Lasts for up to 10 seconds and while the barrier is active you have 50% Slow Resistance.

item.lore: If one truly listens, they can always rely upon the wind to make its will known.
